scope: Empirical file-size benchmark of 42 unapproved crop candidates, not automatic import or editorial verification.

assumptions.sampleSelection: Six purposively selected candidates per edition; not a random sample or a confidence interval. Pages match the current extracted report, boundaries are not fully reviewed.
assumptions.cropCoordinates: PDF points, 72pt/in; top-left origin. Native segmentQuestions regions retained in printed reading order, no visual reconstruction, no OCR.
assumptions.render: Poppler direct pixel crop at150/200DPI; white opaque sRGB8bit; metadata removed via ImageMagick. PNG24 compression6; WebP losslessquality100/method4; lossyquality82/method4.
assumptions.scopeLimit: Original exams and answer keys are unchanged. Crops may include neighboring/header content or omit required shared context and must not be published from this benchmark.
assumptions.projection: Sample mean multiplied by question count, includes all candidate fragments. One delivery variant, no cache or transfer overhead. Storage variants/backups/PDFs are additional.
assumptions.memory: RGBA estimate=width*height*4, RGB=width*height*3. Not a browser heap, decoding time, mobile readability or network latency measurement.

qualityCheck.scope: Six raster comparisons, three candidates at150/200DPI; only200DPI variants visually viewed. Numeric equality checks encoding, not PDF source fidelity or boundary correctness.

examples.visualInspection: Not visually inspected in this resolution; automated raster metrics only.

qualityCheck.recommendation: Use WebP lossless as the default technical candidate, subject to renderer/crop review. Q82 is optional after visual review and measurement; it is not always smaller for text/line-art and changes pixels. Original PDF remains the preserved source.
